dxgive.evidence_source: [/page/2/Text/17] Of the 509 adolescents who underwent screening from April 1, 1999, through January 31, 2002, 183 (35.9%) were initially eligible for baseline assessment, but 23 (12.6%) of the 183 were determined to be ineligible by the baseline assessment. Thus, 160 (31.4%) of those undergoing screening were eligible for the study. Of the 160 eligible, 96 (60.0%) refused to participate (Figure 1). Refusal to participate was not related to adolescent sex.
